about.title: About Me
about.name: Pantelis Stanimeros
about.description1: Based in Thessaloniki, I hold a Bachelor's in Computer Science and an MSc in AI & Data Analytics. I build websites, mobile apps, and custom dashboards, tools that save time, cut costs, and help businesses make better decisions every day.
about.description2: I also tackle harder business problems: finding the best schedule when there are hundreds of constraints, training AI on your own data, or building a system that picks the optimal route, allocation, or plan automatically. If it's a problem that costs your business time or money, there's likely a smart solution for it.

aboutPage.title: About Pantelis Stanimeros
aboutPage.intro: I'm Pantelis Stanimeros, a software engineer based in Thessaloniki, Greece.

background.title: Background
background.paragraph: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and an MSc in AI & Data Analytics. That shapes how I work: solid engineering foundations, with machine learning and data-driven thinking added wherever it adds real value, not just as a buzzword.

problems.title: The kind of problems I like solving
problems.paragraph: I build websites, mobile apps, and custom dashboards, tools that save time, cut costs, and improve decisions. I'm also drawn to harder problems: optimal scheduling under dozens of constraints, training AI on your own data, or systems that work out the best route or allocation automatically.

whyWorkWithMe.title: Why businesses work with me
whyWorkWithMe.paragraph: Businesses come to me when their team is stuck on repetitive tasks, making decisions on gut feeling instead of data, or lacking real-time visibility into what's happening. I work end-to-end, from the first call through launch and support, so you get a working solution, not undocumented code handed off and forgotten.

aiAutomation.question: How does AI automation actually work for my business?
aiAutomation.answer: AI automation handles tasks automatically on your behalf, answering customer questions, processing requests, sending follow-ups, or running internal workflows. You define what it should do, and it runs 24/7 without needing someone to manage it manually. Think of it as a team member that never sleeps and never makes the same mistake twice.

technicalKnowledge.question: Do I need technical knowledge to use what you build?
technicalKnowledge.answer: Not at all. Everything is built with the end user in mind, whether that's you, your team, or your customers. You get a simple interface to manage things, and I handle all the technical complexity behind the scenes. If something needs explaining, I'll walk you through it in plain language.

aiTrainingData.question: What kind of data do I need to train an AI on my business?
aiTrainingData.answer: It depends on what you want the AI to do. For customer support AI, your existing documents, FAQs, or product descriptions are enough. For predictions or recommendations, historical records like past orders, schedules, or outcomes work well. You don't need a huge dataset — even a few hundred records can be a good starting point. We'll assess what you have and what's possible.

optimizationProblems.question: What kind of problems can you solve with optimization?
optimizationProblems.answer: Any problem where you're trying to find the best arrangement, schedule, or allocation, and doing it manually takes too long or gives poor results. Common examples: employee scheduling with shift constraints, delivery route planning, matching resources to tasks, or deciding the optimal mix of products or services. If it feels like a puzzle your business solves repeatedly, it can likely be automated and optimized.

hiddenFees.question: Are there any hidden fees?
hiddenFees.answer: No hidden fees. All costs are discussed and agreed upfront before any work begins. If your project requires third-party services like cloud hosting or AI API usage, those are explained clearly so you know exactly what you're paying for.

timeToLaunch.question: How long does it take to build and deploy?
timeToLaunch.answer: You'll see a working prototype in 3–7 days. From there, a finalized, launch-ready project typically takes a few weeks, depending on complexity. After the free strategy call, you'll get a clear timeline before committing to anything.

ownership.question: Do I own the site and code once it's done?
ownership.answer: Yes, 100%. Everything I build is yours: the code, the design, the hosting setup. There's no lock-in, and you're free to move it, extend it, or hand it to another developer whenever you want.

seo.question: Will my site actually show up on Google and AI tools?
seo.answer: Every site and landing page I build ships SEO-ready: proper meta tags, structured data, and fast load times from day one. That's the foundation Google needs to index and rank you. I also cover GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), so your business shows up in answers from AI tools like ChatGPT or Google's AI Overviews. How fast you climb after that also depends on your content and competition.

noContent.question: I don't have photos, a logo, or brand colors yet. Is that a problem?
noContent.answer: Not at all. Tell me what you have in mind, or show me a site you like, and I'll put together a design direction for you, photos, logo, and colors included if you need them.

payBeforeSeeing.question: How does payment work?
payBeforeSeeing.answer: Nothing is locked in until you have a clear scope and price: the free strategy call gets you both within 2 hours, no surprises. From there, a deposit starts the work, and you'll see a working prototype in 3–7 days, so you know early that it's on track.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Projects I've built, from mobile apps to web platforms.

party.title: Party - Play with friends
party.description: Mobile app with local multiplayer party games on one phone, pass it around, fully offline, no accounts needed.
party.overview: Party is a pass-the-phone game app for iOS and Android, built for one device and a room full of people. It bundles acting games, word games, quizzes, dares, and party classics into a single app, so groups always have something to play. There are no accounts to set up and no internet needed, just hand the phone around and go. It's made for game nights and anywhere the group has no signal, with English and Greek support.
highlights: Multiple game types in one app
Pass-the-phone local multiplayer, no devices needed
Fully offline, no internet required
English and Greek language support

nourea.title: Nourea
nourea.description: Mobile app that generates personalized 4-week nutrition plans from a health and lifestyle questionnaire.
nourea.overview: Nourea is a mobile app for iOS and Android that turns a short health and lifestyle questionnaire into a personalized 4-week nutrition plan. Users answer questions about their goals, dietary preferences, and daily routine, and an AI engine generates a structured meal plan tailored to that profile. It's built for people who want individualized guidance on what to eat without hiring a nutritionist. The 4-week structure gives users a clear, manageable planning horizon they can follow and revisit.
highlights: AI-generated 4-week personalized nutrition plans
Onboarding questionnaire captures health and lifestyle data
Native apps for both iOS and Android
Structured meal planning tailored to individual goals

chronal.title: Chronal
chronal.description: Mobile app for planning and managing trips, with synced itineraries and live currency exchange rates.
chronal.overview: Chronal is a mobile app for planning and organizing trips on iOS and Android. It brings together itineraries, bookings, and countdowns for every upcoming trip in one place, tracks travel spending against a budget with live currency exchange rates, and pins favorite places, restaurants, and stays on a map. Trip data syncs across devices, so plans stay up to date whether you're preparing at home or checking details on the road.
highlights: Itinerary and countdown for every trip
Expense tracking with live currency rates
Map pins for stays, food, and sights
Packing lists organized by category

irisdrop.title: irisdrop
irisdrop.description: SaaS for print shops: customers upload files without USB or email; admins see a live queue feed.
irisdrop.overview: Irisdrop replaces email threads and USB sticks at print shop counters with a single QR code. Customers scan it, add their name, and drop a file from their phone, no account required. The shop's admin dashboard shows the upload the instant it lands in a live, private queue, so staff can download, print, and clear each job without leaving the counter.
highlights: Unique QR code and link per shop
Mobile-first upload page, no customer account
Live admin queue updates instantly
Free and Premium tiers with EUR pricing

fireMessage.title: Fire Message
fireMessage.description: Mobile app for iOS and Android to send push notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging.
fireMessage.overview: Fire Message is a developer tool for iOS and Android that lets you send and test Firebase Cloud Messaging push notifications from your phone. You manage multiple Firebase projects, switch between dev, staging, and production, and compose messages with custom payloads targeted at device tokens, topics, or conditions. A send history logs every message and its response, and service account credentials stay encrypted on-device, never uploaded anywhere.
highlights: Manage multiple Firebase projects and environments
Send to device tokens, topics, or conditions
Send history with duplicate and resend support
Credentials encrypted on-device, never uploaded

ridefast.title: RideFast
ridefast.description: Reservation system for transfers and taxis with real-time booking, payments, and mapping.
ridefast.overview: RideFast is a reservation platform built for transfer and taxi operators who need to manage bookings from a single system. Customers can request rides, see live vehicle locations on a map, and pay online without phone calls or manual dispatch. Operators get a real-time view of active trips, drivers, and payments, cutting down on the back-and-forth that usually slows down taxi and transfer bookings.
highlights: Real-time booking and trip tracking on a map
Integrated online payments at checkout
Built for taxi and transfer operators
Live vehicle location and dispatch view

atproPartner.title: ATPro Partner
atproPartner.description: Appointment and transfer management for hotels and transport companies.
atproPartner.overview: ATPro Partner is a route management tool for transfer agencies, shuttle companies, taxi drivers, and VIP transfer services. Available on iOS, Android, and as a Web App, it lets teams register, edit, and monitor daily transfers, then assign routes to drivers and vans with real-time sync. Each route's status is tracked from pending through in progress to completed, cutting down idle time and double-bookings.
highlights: Assign routes to drivers and vans
Real-time sync across the fleet
Track route status end to end
Push notifications for booking updates

athensMytransfer.title: Athens MyTransfer
athensMytransfer.description: Landing page for transfers in Athens with booking-focused user flow.
athensMytransfer.overview: Athens MyTransfer is a booking-focused landing page for a private transfer service in Athens, covering airport and port pickups plus day tours to destinations like Sounio, Delphi, and Meteora. It targets families, couples, business travelers, and cruise passengers who need reliable transport with English-speaking drivers. The page presents fixed, upfront pricing by route and lets visitors book directly through an online form, live chat, or WhatsApp.
highlights: Fixed pricing shown per route, no hidden fees
Booking via web form, live chat, or WhatsApp
Airport, port, and city transfer coverage
Day tour options to Sounio, Delphi, Meteora

mealAi.title: Meal AI
mealAi.description: AI-powered app that scans food items for nutrition tracking.
mealAi.overview: Meal AI is a mobile app for iOS and Android that uses computer vision to identify food from a photo and log it for nutrition tracking. Instead of manually searching a database or entering meals by hand, users point their camera at a plate and the app scans and recognizes the food items automatically. It's built for people who want to track what they eat without the friction of typical calorie-counting apps.
highlights: Camera-based food recognition and scanning
Automatic nutrition data lookup per item
Native apps for both iOS and Android
Fast meal logging without manual search

near.title: Near
near.description: Privacy-focused social app for location sharing with full data control.
near.overview: Near is a privacy-focused location-sharing app for iOS and Android, built for people who want to stay in touch without losing control of their data. It uses maps to show trusted contacts where you are in real time, while giving you clear say over who sees your location and for how long. Unlike typical location-sharing apps, Near treats privacy as the default, not an afterthought.
highlights: Real-time location sharing on a live map
Granular, per-contact privacy controls
Native iOS and Android apps
AI-assisted, data-minimizing location updates

hedeos.title: hedeos.gr
hedeos.description: Gamified app for learning Greek with quizzes and progress tracking.
hedeos.overview: Hedeos is a mobile app for iOS and Android that helps people build their Greek vocabulary one word at a time. Each day it surfaces a new word with a clear definition and example, then reinforces it with a short daily quiz. Users can save favorite words for quick review, share them with friends, and browse previously learned words offline, with daily reminders to keep the habit going.
highlights: New Greek word introduced every day
Daily quizzes to test recall
Definitions with real usage examples
Offline access to saved words

statwise.title: Statwise
statwise.description: Mobile app that connects to your GA4 property and turns your app's analytics into a clean, plain-language dashboard.
statwise.overview: Statwise is a mobile app for iOS and Android built for solo and indie app developers who don't want to dig through the GA4 web console for a daily-glance answer to "how's my app doing?". After a quick Google OAuth sign-in and property picker, it shows active/new/returning users, sessions, engagement rate, day-by-day trends, and device/platform/country breakdowns, plus cohort retention, all in plain language instead of GA4 terminology. A shared date range selector keeps every screen in sync with prior-period comparisons, and reports are cached on-device so switching tabs doesn't burn through GA4's API quota.
highlights: Google OAuth sign-in with a GA4 property picker
Plain-language dashboard: users, sessions, retention, and trends
Device, platform, and country breakdowns with cohort retention
On-device report caching with pull-to-refresh

ekarotsi.title: e-karotsi.gr
ekarotsi.description: E-commerce platform for a Greek supermarket with delivery and inventory management.
ekarotsi.overview: e-karotsi.gr is an e-commerce platform built for a Greek supermarket, letting customers browse products and place online orders for home delivery. On the operations side, it includes inventory management tools so the store can track stock levels and keep the online catalog aligned with what's actually available. The platform covers the full order flow, from product selection through checkout to delivery.
highlights: Online product catalog and ordering
Home delivery for supermarket orders
Inventory and stock management
Store-side order and catalog tools

transHellas.title: Trans Hellas
transHellas.description: Logistics app for parcels between Germany and Greece.
transHellas.overview: Trans Hellas Reisen's platform manages parcel shipping between Germany and Greece, connecting stations in cities like Düsseldorf, Dortmund, Frankfurt, Köln, München and Stuttgart with weekly routes to Greece, including bus-station (KTEL) delivery. An admin panel lets staff create and track orders, manage stations and DPD courier shipments, and forward online purchases (eBay, Amazon) from Germany to recipients in Greece.
highlights: Admin panel for orders and stations
DPD courier shipment tracking
Weekly Germany-Greece delivery routes
Online order forwarding from eBay, Amazon

etui.title: Etui Creations
etui.description: Luxury jewelry packaging e-commerce for rings, necklaces, and accessories with customization.
etui.overview: Etui Creations designs luxury jewelry packaging, cases and pouches for rings, necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and watches, made from suede, textured faux leather, velvet, and satin. Jewelers and handmade-jewelry makers can personalize each piece with their own logo via hot-foil stamping, screen printing, or digital printing, choosing from a wide range of colors. Orders start at small quantities, with bulk pricing from 200 pieces per year.
highlights: Cases for rings, necklaces, bracelets, watches, earrings
Logo personalization via hot-foil, screen, or digital printing
Suede, faux leather, velvet, and satin materials
Flexible order quantities with volume pricing tiers

tattooHealer.title: Tattoo Healer
tattooHealer.description: Platform for personalized tattoo aftercare with educational content and artist connections.
tattooHealer.overview: Tattoo Healer is a digital aftercare platform for tattoo artists and studios, replacing paper sheets and repeated explanations with one place clients return to. Clients access their plan via a QR or text code, getting washing and cream reminders, a video library on proper care, and a personal healing tracker. Artists and studios build instructions once and share them with every client, keeping aftercare consistent.
highlights: QR or text code plan sharing with clients
Push reminders for washing and cream application
Video library covering aftercare do's and don'ts
Studio admin panel for team-wide branded plans

veridictum.title: Veridictum AI
veridictum.overview: Veridictum is an AI-powered workspace for legal professionals to manage cases, documents, and research in one platform. Users can chat with their uploaded case files, search a library of court opinions and precedents, and run comparative analysis against similar cases to gauge case strength and outcomes. A built-in stress-test feature argues the opposing side to surface weaknesses and counter-arguments before trial.
highlights: AI chat over your uploaded case documents
Searchable library of court opinions and precedents
Comparative analysis against similar past cases
Stress-tests cases from opposing counsel's perspective

process.title: Process
process.description: Production monitoring and tracking system for manufacturing.
process.overview: Process is an order and production tracking system for small manufacturing businesses like custom furniture workshops. It manages the full order lifecycle, from customer quotes through production tasks scheduled across phases such as assembly and finishing, letting staff start and stop each task in real time. A dashboard tracks scheduled versus actual work per day, order status, and orders per phase, alongside customer records and delivery dates.
highlights: Real-time start/stop tracking for production tasks
Order lifecycle from quote to delivery
Dashboard charts scheduled vs actual production
Customer records with quotes and order history

skiGreece.title: Ski Greece
skiGreece.description: Platform for Greek ski resorts and winter sports centers.
skiGreece.overview: Ski Greece is a directory platform for Greece's ski resorts and winter sports centers. Each resort page shows an interactive map, live weather and snow conditions, and its trails (pistes) with the lifts that serve them, plus lift pass pricing. Beyond winter, it also lists summer activities at these mountain destinations. Resort managers get their own dashboard to update content, photos, and pricing.
highlights: Interactive map for every ski resort
Live weather and snow condition updates
Trail listings linked to their lifts
Manager dashboard for resort content and pricing

nikiMargariti.title: Niki Margariti Lab
nikiMargariti.description: AI chatbot for students in Greece with educational support.
nikiMargariti.overview: Niki Margariti Lab is an AI chatbot built for students in Greece, offering educational support directly through conversation. It helps students work through academic questions and topics in a familiar chat interface, accessible from any browser. The product focuses on making academic help approachable and available on demand, without requiring specialized software or setup.
highlights: AI-powered chatbot for education
Built for Greek students
Browser-based chat interface
Academic support on demand

childrensPrivacy.title: Children's Privacy
childrensPrivacy.description: This app is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.

changesToPolicy.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changesToPolicy.description: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the "Last updated" date. You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes.

contactUs.title: Contact Us
contactUs.description: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR Art. 6)
legalBasis.description: We process your personal data on the following legal bases:
items: Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): analytics cookies and tracking, only after you accept via the cookie banner.
Legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)): security, fraud prevention, and basic site functionality.
Legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)): where required by applicable law.

internationalTransfers.title: International Data Transfers
internationalTransfers.description: We use third-party service providers based in the USA for analytics and infrastructure. These providers participate in the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and process data under Standard Contractual Clauses, providing adequate protection under GDPR Art. 46.

cookies.title: Cookies
items: Analytics cookies: used to understand how visitors interact with the site. Only set after you give consent. Retained for up to 14 months.
Preference cookies: store your cookie consent choice (cookie_consent). Retained for 1 year.
No advertising or third-party tracking cookies are used.
cookies.note: You can withdraw your consent at any time by clearing your browser's local storage or cookies.

dataDeletionLink.description: To request deletion of your data, please visit our data deletion page.

dataDeletion.title: Request Data Deletion
dataDeletion.subtitle: Submit a request to delete your personal data from the app

importantInformation.title: Important Information
items: Data deletion is permanent and cannot be undone
This process may take up to 30 days to complete
We may need to verify your identity before processing

accountDeletionPolicy.title: Account Deletion Request - {{appName}}
accountDeletionPolicy.intro: We value your privacy and provide a simple way for you to manage your data.
accountDeletionPolicy.appIntro: If you are a user of the {{appName}} application and wish to delete your account and all associated data, please follow the instructions below:
accountDeletionPolicy.howToIntro: You can request account deletion in either of the following ways:
accountDeletionPolicy.howToOptionEmail: Contact us by email at {{email}} with the subject line "Account Deletion Request" and include the email address or username associated with your {{appName}} account.
accountDeletionPolicy.howToOptionForm: Fill out the Data Deletion Request form at the end of this page.
accountDeletionPolicy.whatDataIntro: Upon receiving your request, we will delete the following data from our servers within 30 days:
dataItems: Any user-generated content associated with your account
accountDeletionPolicy.note: Note: Some data may be retained for a limited period if required by law or for legitimate security purposes.

form.title: Data Deletion Request Form
form.appNamePlaceholder: Enter the name of the application
form.reasonPlaceholder: Please explain why you want to delete your data...
form.deleteAccount: I also want to delete my account (authentication credentials) in addition to my data
form.confirm: I understand that this action is permanent and cannot be undone. I confirm that I want to delete all my personal data from the specified application.
form.verify: I confirm that I am the rightful owner of this account and have the authority to request data deletion.

contact.description: Need help or have questions about data deletion?

privacyPolicyLink.description: To learn how we handle your data, please read our privacy policy.

success.title: Request Submitted Successfully
success.description: Thank you for your data deletion request. We have received your submission and will process it within 30 days as required by data protection regulations.
steps: We will review your request and verify your identity within 3-5 business days.
You will receive a confirmation email with a reference number for tracking.
Your data will be permanently deleted within 30 days of verification.
You will receive a final confirmation email once deletion is complete.

cookieBanner.title: We use cookies
cookieBanner.message: We use cookies for analytics to improve your experience.
cookieBanner.learnMoreLabel: Learn more about our privacy policy
